back: Zero-shot uses the pre-trained model as it is. Fine-tuning continues training on your data, with a held-out later period for testing.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning: train small extra matrices, keep the main weights frozen. Cheaper and less prone to overfit.
Models make different errors, so averaging cancels part of them. Independent errors shrink by the square root of the number of models.

front: What is a router in forecasting?
back: A rule or model that picks which forecasting model to use for each series or group, from validation errors or series features.

front: How do you avoid router overfitting?
back: Long validation windows, several origins, group-level routing, simple rules, and a later held-out test period.
